Produces: Infinite +1/+1 counters on creatures you control; Infinite Treasure tokens; Infinite card draw; Infinite colored mana; Infinite colorless mana; Infinite creature tokens; Near-infinite lifeloss; Put all creature cards from your library onto the battlefield; Infinite artifact tokens; Return most creature cards from your graveyard onto the battlefield; Infinite artifact ETB; Infinite artifact LTB; Infinite artifact sacrifice triggers; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite death triggers; Infinite draw triggers; Infinite creature sacrifice triggers; Put all basic lands from your library into your hand
Start: Preston, the Vanisher (battlefield); Delney, Streetwise Lookout (battlefield); Sefris of the Hidden Ways (battlefield); Ashnod's Altar (battlefield); Feywild Caretaker (graveyard)
Prerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
Steps: Complete a dungeon.
  Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
  Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
  Resolve the second trigger, returning Feywild Caretaker from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
  When Feywild Caretaker enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
  Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Feywild Caretaker.
  Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Feywild Caretaker that is a 0/1 Illusion.
  When the Feywild Caretaker token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
  Resolve the Feywild Caretaker token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
  Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Feywild Caretaker that is a 0/1 Illusion.
  Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
  Resolve the Feywild Caretaker trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
  Repeat from step 2.
Notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

Produces: Infinite +1/+1 counters on creatures you control; Infinite Treasure tokens; Infinite card draw; Infinite colored mana; Infinite creature tokens; Near-infinite lifeloss; Put all creature cards from your library onto the battlefield; Infinite artifact tokens; Return most creature cards from your graveyard onto the battlefield; Infinite artifact ETB; Infinite artifact LTB; Infinite artifact sacrifice triggers; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite death triggers; Infinite draw triggers; Infinite creature sacrifice triggers; Put all basic lands from your library into your hand
Start: Preston, the Vanisher (battlefield); Delney, Streetwise Lookout (battlefield); Sefris of the Hidden Ways (battlefield); Carrion Feeder (battlefield); Tomb of Horrors Adventurer (graveyard)
Prerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
Steps: Complete a dungeon.
  Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
  Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
  Resolve the second trigger, returning Tomb of Horrors Adventurer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
  When Tomb of Horrors Adventurer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
  Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Tomb of Horrors Adventurer.
  Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Tomb of Horrors Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
  When the Tomb of Horrors Adventurer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
  Resolve the Tomb of Horrors Adventurer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
  Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Tomb of Horrors Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
  Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
  Resolve the Tomb of Horrors Adventurer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
  Repeat from step 2.
Notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

Start: Preston, the Vanisher (battlefield); Delney, Streetwise Lookout (battlefield); Sefris of the Hidden Ways (battlefield); Bloodflow Connoisseur (battlefield); White Plume Adventurer (graveyard)

  Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.

  Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing White Plume Adventurer.

  When the White Plume Adventurer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.

  Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.

  Repeat from step 2.
Notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

  Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.

Start: Preston, the Vanisher (battlefield); Delney, Streetwise Lookout (battlefield); Sefris of the Hidden Ways (battlefield); Ravenloft Adventurer (graveyard); Phantom Train (battlefield)
Prerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
Steps: Complete a dungeon.
  Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
  Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
  Resolve the second trigger, returning Ravenloft Adventurer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
  When Ravenloft Adventurer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
  Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Ravenloft Adventurer.
  Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Ravenloft Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
  When the Ravenloft Adventurer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
  Resolve the Ravenloft Adventurer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
  Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Ravenloft Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
  Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
  Resolve the Ravenloft Adventurer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
  Repeat from step 2.
Notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

## Combo 1938-3742-3991
Cards: Glorious Protector + Phantom Steed + Faceless Butcher
Color identity: WUB | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 10 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
Produces: Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature LTB
Start: Glorious Protector (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield); Phantom Steed (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield); Faceless Butcher (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield)
Prerequisites: Faceless Butcher must be exiled by Phantom Steed, and Glorious Protector must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
Steps: Cast Glorious Protector for its mana cost.
  When Glorious Protector enters, it exiles Phantom Steed until Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Glorious Protector's ETB.
  When Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield, Faceless Butcher is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  When Faceless Butcher enters, it exiles Glorious Protector until Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Faceless Butcher's ETB.
  When Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield, Phantom Steed is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  When Phantom Steed enters, it exiles Faceless Butcher until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Phantom Steed's ETB.
  When Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield, Glorious Protector is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  Repeat from step 2.
Notes: Due to differences in card templating between the various banisher effects (linked triggered abilities vs "until" clause), steps 3, 5, and 7 may return the creature to the battlefield during the resolution of the preceding step rather than creating a separate event. This should not affect the overall execution of the combo, only how many objects pass through the stack (and thus rounds of priority available per loop).

Color identity: WUB | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 14 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
Produces: Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature LTB
Start: Glorious Protector (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield); Hostage Taker (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield); Werefox Bodyguard (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield)
Prerequisites: Werefox Bodyguard must be exiled by Hostage Taker, and Glorious Protector must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
Steps: Cast Glorious Protector for its mana cost.
  When Glorious Protector enters, it exiles Hostage Taker until Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Glorious Protector's ETB.
  When Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield, Werefox Bodyguard is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  When Werefox Bodyguard enters, it exiles Glorious Protector until Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Werefox Bodyguard's ETB.
  When Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield, Hostage Taker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  When Hostage Taker enters, it exiles Werefox Bodyguard until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Hostage Taker's ETB.
  When Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield, Glorious Protector is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  Repeat from step 2.
Notes: Due to differences in card templating between the various banisher effects (linked triggered abilities vs "until" clause), steps 3, 5, and 7 may return the creature to the battlefield during the resolution of the preceding step rather than creating a separate event. This should not affect the overall execution of the combo, only how many objects pass through the stack (and thus rounds of priority available per loop).

## Combo 2022-3221
Cards: Wedding Ring + Notion Thief
Color identity: WUB | Bracket: 3-4+ (Spicy) | Popularity: 560 | Commander: legal
Produces: Infinite card draw; Infinite draw triggers
Start: Wedding Ring (battlefield); Notion Thief (battlefield)
Prerequisites: An opponent controls a copy of Wedding Ring.
  You have a way to draw a card.
Steps: Draw a card by any method.
  The opponent's Wedding Ring's second ability triggers, causing them to draw a card.
  Notion Thief causes that opponent to skip that draw, and causes you to draw a card instead.
  Repeat from step 2 until you remove a combo piece from the board at instant speed; if you do not you will draw from an empty library and lose the game.
Notes: The most straightforward use of this combo is in decks that have a way to win the game at instant speed after drawing their deck, for example by putting any Laboratory Maniac effect onto the battlefield at instant speed. This usually requires additional starting mana.

Produces: Infinite +1/+1 counters on a creature; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite creature sacrifice triggers; Infinite death triggers
Start: Genestealer Patriarch (battlefield); Bartolomé del Presidio (battlefield); Reluctant Role Model (battlefield); Rikku, Resourceful Guardian (battlefield)

  An opponent controls a creature.

  You control at least two additional creatures.

  Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.

  Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
  Repeat from step 4.

  Repeat.
